name: Mocking Spongebob
core: Repeat someone's statement in alternating caps to mock it childishly.
slots: the mocked repeat in aLtErNaTiNg cApS
avoid: Genuine agreement or original statements not being echoed.

name: Scumbag Steve
core: Scumbag Steve: selfish, inconsiderate behavior; setup of need followed by antisocial act.
slots: the favor or setup, such as asking for something
the inconsiderate act that undermines it
avoid: Wholesome acts or victim-side stories.

name: Baby, You've Got a Stew Going
core: An exclamation announcing the stew going, usually in a mundane, mocking domestic context.
slots: 'baby, you've got a stew going!' style line
aliases: baby you've got a stew going
avoid: Serious announcements or cooking tutorials.

name: Stonks
core: Confidently smug 'stonks' as a bad financial or life decision is celebrated.
avoid: Genuinely wise financial moves or sincere investing advice.

name: Stop It Patrick You're Scaring Him
core: Patrick makes a dumb misunderstanding while scaring Squidward, until Spongebob scolds him.
slots: the explanation that makes a wrong connection
the scolding: 'stop it, Patrick, you're scaring him!'
avoid: Serious conflicts or jokes lacking an escalation to scaring.

name: Stop It, Get Some Help
core: Command someone to stop a bad behavior and seek help.
avoid: Encouraging a behavior or friendly suggestions.

name: Success Kid
core: Small triumph or lucky win celebrated with a clenched fist.
avoid: Failures, defeats, or big life accomplishments treated seriously.

name: 10 Guy
core: Absurdly illogical behavior in response to a problem, one dumb fix.
avoid: Logical solutions or smart decisions.

name: The Rent Is Too Damn High
core: Jimmy McMillan's rant that something is 'too damn high', a complaint about excess.
slots: the thing complained about, 'the X is'
avoid: Things that are too low or fine.

name: Principal Skinner
core: Skinner wonders if he's out of touch, then blames everyone else instead.
slots: the rhetorical question, 'am I so out of touch?'
the self-assured conclusion that others are wrong
avoid: Genuine self-reflection or admitting fault.

name: At Least You Tried
core: Condescending consolation to someone who failed but made an effort.
slots: 'at least' or the setup of effort
avoid: Real successes or sincere encouragement.

name: Donald Trump
core: Trump-style boastful, superlative claim delivered with absurd confidence.
slots: the hedge or exaggerated addendum, such as 'maybe ever'
avoid: Humble or modest statements.

name: Ugandan Knuckles
core: Crowd of Ugandan Knuckles characters demands that others 'show de wey' or asks 'do u know de wey'.
slots: the 'do u know de wey' demand or question
avoid: serious tone; jokes unrelated to knowing or showing the way

name: Vince McMahon Reaction
core: Vince McMahon's face grows increasingly thrilled across panels as the option gets better.
avoid: binary choices or negative things that disappoint

name: Patrick Star's Wallet
core: Patrick accepts flawed ID logic, then refuses the wallet, exposing the absurdity.
slots: Squidward asks Patrick if he is Patrick
Squidward asks if this is his ID
Squidward says the ID was in the wallet so it's his
Patrick denies the wallet is his
avoid: simple single-punchline jokes; needs a circular logic setup

name: What Are Ya Gonna Do?
core: Resigned shrug at an unfixable bad situation: 'what are ya gonna do?'
avoid: hopeful or triumphant jokes; things that can be fixed

name: We Don't Do That Here
core: Calmly and firmly stating an annoying behavior is not tolerated here.
slots: the annoying or unacceptable behavior or situation
aliases: black panther we don't do that here
avoid: praise or enthusiastic approval; behaviors one actually likes

name: What Year Is It?
core: Someone confused about what year it is after something anachronistic or shocking.
avoid: jokes with no outdated or regressive element

name: Winter is coming
core: Ned Stark-style warning of a coming dreaded event: 'brace yourselves, X is coming'.
avoid: pleasant surprises; events that have already happened

name: Genie Rules
core: Genie grants a wish; the wisher asks for something impossible or a loophole.
slots: the clever, absurd or paradoxical wish
avoid: jokes with no wish or rule-breaking premise

name: Who Killed Hannibal?
core: Someone is killed or harmed, the obvious culprit is ignored, and a bystander asks why the wrong suspect would do it.
slots: the harm or event that occurred
the obvious true cause or culprit, ignored
the baffled question of why the wrong party would do it
avoid: jokes without a misplaced-blame or conspiracy structure

name: Woman Yelling at a Cat
core: Angry woman yells at a confused, unbothered cat at a dinner table.
slots: the accusation or yelling, from the woman
the cat's calm, confused or indifferent response
avoid: jokes without two opposing perspectives or an unbothered side

name: Condescending Wonka
core: Smug, condescending Wonka sarcastically feigns interest in someone's claim to mock them.
slots: the person's claim or situation, 'oh you...'
avoid: sincere praise; jokes lacking a target to condescend to

name: The Worst Day Of Your Life So Far
core: Someone says they're having the worst day; reply: it's the worst day of your life so far, ominously.
slots: the person's complaint about their bad day
'This is the worst day of your life so far.' ominous reply
aliases: worst day of your life so far
avoid: happy situations; jokes with no escalating dread

name: X all the Y
core: Buzz Lightyear presents 'X, X everywhere' with a sweeping gesture, stating abundance.
slots: the X, the thing there is a lot of
avoid: scarcity or subtle, understated jokes

name: Y'all Got Any More of Them
core: Man asks 'y'all got any more of them' about a thing he wants more of.
slots: 'y'all got any more of them' request
aliases: y'all got any more of that
yall got any more of them
avoid: things the speaker dislikes or wants less of

name: Xzibit Yo Dawg
core: Recursive joke: 'I heard you like X so I put X in your X'.
slots: 'yo dawg, i heard you like X'
'so i put X in your X so you can X while you X'
avoid: jokes lacking a recursive or nested structure

name: Y U NO Guy
core: Rage-faced stick figure demands to know why someone won't do the obvious thing.
slots: the action the speaker wishes were done
avoid: calm, subtle, or ironic observations

name: All Your Base Are Belong to Us
core: Broken-English villain line 'all your base are belong to us' declaring domination or takeover.
slots: a takeover declaration phrased as 'all your X are belong to us'
avoid: modern jokes unrelated to takeover or retro gaming

name: Side-Eyeing Chloe
core: A little girl gives a silent, skeptical side-eye at what someone just said or did.
slots: the line or situation: "me: X" or "when he says X"
who is reacting, often just a name and a colon: "her:"
avoid: two-sided dialogue that needs a spoken reply

name: Bernie I Am Once Again Asking
core: A weary, repeated plea: someone asking yet again for the same thing they keep having to request.
avoid: Not for one-off requests or anything not repeated.

name: UNO Draw 25 Cards
core: Someone would rather suffer a huge penalty than do one simple, reasonable thing.
avoid: Not for cases where the person happily does the thing.

name: Boardroom Meeting Suggestion
core: A boss asks for ideas; two safe ones get nods and the one sensible idea gets the person thrown out the window.
slots: the sensible idea that gets him thrown out
avoid: Jokes with no single good idea that gets punished.

name: Waiting Skeleton
core: Waiting so long for something that you've died and decomposed.
avoid: Not for things that arrive quickly.

name: Buff Doge vs. Cheems
core: The strong past (or ideal) version versus the weak present (or real) one.
slots: what the buff doge says or does
avoid: Jokes without a strong-versus-weak contrast.

name: Batman Slapping Robin
core: One person's bad or annoying idea gets cut off mid-sentence by someone shutting it down hard.
avoid: Not for agreeable exchanges or real violence.

name: Blank Nut Button
core: A hand eagerly slamming a button, used for something you can't resist doing every time it comes up.
avoid: Not for reluctant choices or comparing two options.

name: Marked Safe From
core: A fake safety check-in announcing you survived some trivial or absurd threat today.
avoid: Not for real disasters or tragedies.

name: Surprised Pikachu
core: Shock at an outcome that was obvious from what you did.
avoid: Outcomes that were genuinely unexpected.

name: Leonardo DiCaprio Cheers
core: Gatsby raising a glass in a toast, used to salute someone or something people respect or relate to.
slots: who or what is being toasted
avoid: Not for disappointment or failure.

name: The Scroll Of Truth
core: Someone finds the scroll of truth, reads an uncomfortable fact, and angrily throws it away; used for truths people refuse to accept.
avoid: Not for truths people happily accept.

name: 0 Days Without
core: The streak counter reset to zero again because the same mistake keeps happening.
avoid: Not for rare one-time events.

name: The Rock Driving
core: The Rock asks a casual question, the passenger gives an alarming answer, and he turns in shock; used for a reply that's unexpectedly disturbing.
avoid: Not for answers that are pleasant or expected.

name: Sad Pablo Escobar
core: Lonely, bored waiting for something that never comes, across three scenes.
avoid: Excited or active situations.

name: Absolute Cinema
core: Declaring something a perfect, masterful moment, often ironically for something mundane.
avoid: Not for criticism or disappointment.

name: Squidward Window
core: Watching others have fun from a distance while you're stuck inside, left out or working.
avoid: Not for when you're the one having fun.

name: This Is Where I'd Put My Trophy If I Had One
core: Proudly showing off the empty spot where an achievement would be, admitting you never got it.
avoid: Not for things you actually achieved or genuine bragging.

name: Megamind Peeking
core: A smug, pouting "No X?" question teasing someone for lacking something.
avoid: Not for sincere questions or cheerful reactions.

name: Pawn Stars Best I Can Do
core: Lowballing someone's offer with an insultingly small counteroffer.
avoid: Not for fair deals or generous offers.

name: I Bet He's Thinking About Other Women
core: She suspects he's thinking about other women while he's actually obsessing over something trivial or nerdy.
aliases: he's probably thinking about other women
avoid: Not for actual cheating or relationship drama.

name: Soldier Protecting Sleeping Child
core: Someone takes every attack to shield something they love that's blissfully unaware.
avoid: Not for real war or violence news.

name: They Don't Know
core: A loner at a party privately smug about a niche secret or achievement nobody else cares about.
avoid: Not for big public achievements or group fun.

name: Grandma Finds The Internet
core: A grandma squinting at a laptop, used for someone naively misunderstanding technology or the internet.
avoid: Not for tech-savvy or expert behavior.

name: Finding Neverland
core: A teary boy asks a hopeful question and the man gives a gentle, crushing answer before they hug; used for delivering a sad truth.
avoid: Not for happy news or good answers.

name: Monkey Puppet
core: Awkwardly looking away when caught in an uncomfortable or guilty situation.
avoid: Not for confident or proud moments.

name: Unsettled Tom
core: Tom's uneasy, side-eyed stare, used for something quietly disturbing or suspicious that makes you uncomfortable.
avoid: Not for open shock or happy surprise.

name: Imagination Spongebob
core: SpongeBob gleefully suggests an obviously wrong or absurd 'solution' as if it were a brilliant idea; used to mock naive thinking.
avoid: Not for genuine inspiration or praising real creativity.

name: Trump Bill Signing
core: Holding up a freshly signed executive order, used to announce a ridiculous new rule or decree as if official.
avoid: Not for real political news or attacks.

name: Spider-Man Triple
core: Three Spider-Men point at each other, for three things that are basically the same or all blaming each other.
avoid: Not for things that are genuinely different; it's about sameness or mutual blame.

name: Y U No
core: A rage-comic face demanding why someone or something won't do the obvious thing.
slots: Y U NO do the thing
avoid: Not for calm or polite requests.
